facts: The pinned official README documents daily/monthly public archives and says daily data become available the next day.

For SPOT, the pinned official README documents aggTrades, klines and trades. The documented trade rows include price, quantity, quote quantity, time and buyer-maker direction; klines include quote volume and taker-buy volume.
The pinned official README does not document a SPOT historical bid/ask order-book, bookTicker or depth archive family.
Each documented archive has a SHA-256 CHECKSUM sidecar and Binance warns archived files may later be corrected, so source version/checksum must be pinned.
official_source_review.inference: Do not claim strict historical spot spread/depth tradability from Binance Data Vision unless a separately verified source family is found. Spot trades/aggTrades can support PIT participation/aggressive-flow proxies, but they cannot be silently substituted for historical spread or executable L2 depth.
official_source_review.unknown: A free, survivorship-safe historical SPOT L2/BBO source with enough coverage for Cohort 001 has not yet been proven.

approved_next_data_actions.purpose: Accumulate genuine future best-bid/ask and depth snapshots for prospective strict-tradability validation because free historical SPOT depth coverage is currently unproven.
approved_next_data_actions.pit_rule: Capture server/event time plus local receipt time, raw payload hashes, sequence continuity and outage/gap masks; never backfill missing historical snapshots from current books.

blocked_shortcuts: Treating trailing quote volume or ADV as proof of strict execution quality
Inferring historical spot spread from candle high-low range
Using futures book depth as a substitute for spot depth
Using live/current order books to backfill historical decisions
Dropping symbols/dates after learning that microstructure data are missing
Forward-filling order-book gaps across outages without a predeclared rule
